Kiṣkindhā
------------------------------------------
Kiṣkindhā was the capital of the vānara race, ruled first by वालि and later by सुग्रीव.
It was probably situated within a mountain range, the passage to it being through a cave. According to the description given in the Rāmāyaṇa (Kiṣkindhā-kāṇḍa) it was a spacious and well-designed city provided with all the things needed for a comfortable life.
The modern small town of Anegondi near हम्पि in the Bellary district of Karnataka has been identified as the seat of the ancient किष्किन्धा.
